title: contest-control signed command
description: Canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, trailing \n), Ed25519-signed. The signature covers the exact bytes; verify before parsing, the same way overlay/usr/lib/contest/update.sh verifies the update manifest.

args.description: Empty for lock/unlock/reset-home/reboot/poweroff/usb-block/usb-unblock/precontest/donottouch/cantouch/net-open/net-lock. {text} for message. {hosts:[...]} for set-allowlist. {url} for set-wallpaper (host must be on the network allowlist). precontest = lock + usb-block + server-side lock_state. donottouch/cantouch freeze/unfreeze command delivery. net-open/net-lock lift or reinstate the whole nftables lockdown.

machine_id.description: Target machine id, or '*' for every machine in the group.
